description: This file defines a utility enumeration 'OpenClawNodeStorage' that provides static methods for constructing URLs pointing to various storage directories related to the application, such as application support, caches, and canvas snapshots, with session-specific subdirectories.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the application's support directory, or throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL to the canvas directory within the app support directory, namespaced by session key.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the caches directory, or throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL to the canvas snapshots directory within the caches directory, namespaced by session key.
